verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing docs show generic virtual card creation, transaction rules, merchant category restrictions, and dynamic spending limits (docs-1, docs-18, docs-22), but nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI agents, autonomous purchasing, or an agent-specific card use case by name — the core requirement of the story. Missing for 10: any vendor documentation naming AI agents/autonomous agents as a use case, agent-specific expiry/merchant-lock configuration examples, or case studies of agentic purchasing.
